parsing_traps: Portfolio Statement (p132-145) is a FACING-PAGE POSITIONAL SPLIT: description columns (name/tenure/location) on even pages, value columns (gross revenue/occupancy/valuation, '000) on the next odd page with a BLANK label column aligned by row position. The deterministic HTML adapter cannot positionally-join these -> properties extracted llm_only by pairing description+value pages.
